A live audio webcast of the conference call will also be available via the Company's website, investors.loandepot.com , under the Events Presentation tab. A replay of the webcast will be made available following the conclusion of the event. articles.summary: Strategic expansion and continued productivity gains drive higher unit volume, stronger margins and improved operating efficiency despite rising interest rates and a challenging housing market. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights: Origination volume declined 12% to $7.05 billion, while unit volume increased 7% from the second quarter of 2026, reflecting continued momentum in the Company’s expansion of home equity lending products. Revenue decreased 9% to $307 million and adjusted revenue decreased 2% to $302 million compared to the prior quarter, primarily due to lower origination income resulting from reduced mortgage volumes. Pull-through weighted gain on sale margin increased 54 basis points to 399 basis points, driven by deliberate shift toward higher-margin home equity loans. Operating leverage strengthened as expenses decreased by a greater amount than adjusted revenue, reflecting investment in productivity initiatives and benefits of a more efficient product mix. articles.summary: Builder partnership expands loanDepot’s joint venture channel and diversified origination platform while providing seamless financing for homebuyers loanDepot, Inc. (NYSE: LDI) (together with its subsidiaries, “loanDepot”), a national retail lender with $600 billion funded directly to consumers, and Davidson Homes , a leading regional homebuilder ranked No. 43 on the 2026 Builder 100, today announced Davidson Mortgage, a new joint venture that will provide seamless mortgage services for homebuyers. Davidson Mortgage combines loanDepot’s technology-forward lending platform, broad range of financing options and exceptional customer service with Davidson Homes’ commitment to creating an outstanding homebuying experience. By more closely connecting the home purchase and financing processes, the joint venture will give buyers personalized support and a seamless experience from contract to closing.
